verdict.rationale: Docs show a remote-daemon/task model where a running session can be observed and controlled live from app.humanlayer.com or a phone, and the UI supports live multiplayer presence, diff/PR views and task history, implying real-time visibility into agent activity. However, no explicit documentation describes a dedicated 'status' indicator (e.g., running/waiting/blocked) or a status API, so the specific 'current status' element of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit status/state display feature, independent hands-on confirmation of real-time status monitoring.
